module: Flowgraph node 'Update Display Drag Race' (repeat_instant category) for the drag race mission: displays the player's time and speed on the quarter-mile board by changing the shape (shapeName) of the scene objects display_time_i_l/r and display_speed_i_l/r (models art/shapes/quarter_mile_display/display_<digit>.dae). The 'side' pin ('l' or 'r') chooses the side; the speed in m/s is converted to mph (x2.237).
notes: The description of the 'side' and 'velocity' pins is identical ('Velocity of the players vehicle'): copy-paste in the code.
The m/s to mph conversion is done with a condition 'velocity == 0 and velocity or velocity*2.237'.
If the scene does not have the display_* objects, indexing nil raises an error.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

postInit.desc: Defines the offered values for the 'side' pin: left=l, right=r.

updateDisplay.desc: Builds the list of digits (time with 3 decimals, speed with 2) and applies the right model to each of the 5 displays of the chosen side; an 'empty' is added for the leading zero.

insertDigits.desc: Searches the scene for the 20 objects display_time_i_l/r and display_speed_i_l/r (i from 1 to 5) and stores them.

_executionStarted.desc: Clears the display lists and sets the flow output to false.

work.desc: On reset: finds the displays again and resets the display to 0. Otherwise, if time, velocity and side are provided, updates the display; flow=true.
